title: Chubb Megathon 2025 - Churns by Chubbs
summary: A hackathon project predicting customer churn for Chubb Insurance using KNN, EBM, LLM-based insights, and news/stock sentiment scrapers. Its model/ctgan_data.py script builds a SingleTableMetadata object and trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer to generate scalable synthetic training data.
evidence: ctgan_data.py:3 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer'; synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, batch_size=1240, epochs=1000, embedding_dim=512)
